ideas.pitch: Real-time bus crowding and delay predictor using computer vision feeds from campus shuttles to optimize student transit routes.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the judges feel themselves daily getting around the Blacksburg campus.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered campus health clinic triage assistant that matches student symptoms with SCHiffert Health Center availability and local pharmacy inventory.
ideas.title: SymptomRoute VT
